is held and listed here, and there is no bulk close of the > 30 d tail without approved wording.

**What is not here:**

under-24 h set, the hand reading in `report-1026.md` section 6 overrides them: 4 claim disputes,
2 with no line, 2 close-with-reason, 3 merge.
